Subcompact Brushless 3/8” Drill/Driver Bare Tool features the most compact and lightest weight drill/driver, providing ultimate access into tight spaces. The compact drill is only 5.4” in length and under 2 pounds with a battery, allowing for minimal fatigue and excellent control, especially while working overhead or in tight spaces. The brushless motor delivers optimal tool performance at 350 in-lbs. of torque and up to 1,550 RPM, tackling a wide range of drilling and fastening applications. The drill features premium components, including a 3/8” metal chuck, providing best-in-class durability. MILWAUKEE® REDLINK™ Intelligence communicates with the M12™ REDLITHIUM™ batteries (sold separately) to deliver optimal performance for the tools.
